headline: Ashish Tomar Files SEBI Reg 31(4) Substantial Acquisition Disclosure for EMS Limited
sum: Ashish Tomar filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE for EMS Limited on 19 June 2026. Full consideration, acquisition percentage and corporate structure details remain unconfirmed pending access to the underlying PDF filing or corroborating company announcement.
implication: Substantial acquisition disclosures under SEBI Reg 31(4) trigger mandatory open-offer obligations if the acquirer crosses specified thresholds (25% or higher); counsel must verify the precise acquisition percentage and conditions precedent in the filed document to assess takeover code implications.
detail: Ashish Tomar, an individual acquirer, filed a mandatory substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) with the NSE in respect of EMS Limited on or around 19 June 2026. The disclosure was required under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing indicates a share acquisition above the specified threshold, but the exact percentage, consideration amount, acquisition structure, and conditions precedent are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench summary and require verification from the NSE archival filing or a company announcement.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Central. Mandatory disclosure requirement for any person acquiring shares directly or indirectly above specified thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25% etc.); breach attracts penalties and invalidates voting rights.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 3 & 4
framework.note: Central. Defines 'person acting in concert' and attribution rules for determining aggregate holdings; critical for identifying true acquirer and triggering threshold.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10 & 11
framework.note: Central. Open offer obligation triggered if acquirer and persons acting in concert breach 25%; tender offer mechanics and pricing rules.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Central. Company obligation to make disclosures regarding substantial acquisitions to stock exchanges within prescribed timelines.
Overarching statute; SEBI's takeover code authority and enforcement powers; breach constitutes violation of securities law.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013, Section 150 (Insider Trading Norms & Pre-disclosure Protocol)
framework.note: Compliance requirement; insiders and connected persons restricted from trading during announcements and disclosure windows.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 & Rules thereunder
framework.note: If acquirer is NRI/FPI; FDI cap and sector-specific restrictions apply; RBI approval may be required depending on sector classification of EMS Limited.

conditions: Acquisition threshold trigger (percentage to be confirmed from NSE filing)
SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure within prescribed timelines
Potential open-offer obligation if threshold breaches 25%
structure.novel: Acquisition by individual (Ashish Tomar) rather than corporate entity; no public announcement by EMS Limited yet, suggesting possible private negotiation or strategic stake-build.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure filing within 4 days of crossing threshold; triggers open-offer obligation if 25%+ breached.

triggers.law: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
triggers.note: Material Information disclosure obligation for EMS Limited to stock exchanges.
